description.value: This study investigated whether the APOE ϵ4 allele modulates the morphologic expression of Alzheimer's disease and frontotemporal dementia using voxel by voxel analysis of gray matter concentration.

spans.text: Objective of this study was to investigate the difference in the morphologic expression of FTD and AD in patients carrying the ϵ4 allele of APOE compared to the non-carriers, using voxel by voxel analysis.

value: differences should be evident in the distribution of atrophy between carriers and non-carriers within each disease

we expected more medial temporal, and possibly less frontal atrophy in the AD carrying the ϵ4 allele vs the non-carriers, and greater frontal atrophy in the FTD carrying the allele compared to the non-carriers

spans.text: The hypothesis was that differences should be evident in the distribution of atrophy between carriers and non-carriers within each disease.

description.value: Observational, cross-sectional voxel-based morphometry study of Alzheimer's disease and frontotemporal dementia patients and controls.

definition.value: Greater atrophy of the amygdalae and head of hippocampi in the AD patients carrying the allele compared to the non-carriers.

spans.text: For each subject, a high-resolution sagittal T1-weighted volumetric MRI scan was acquired
